'''Donel do Morny a'Lordeine''' is a Murandian Lord. 

== Appearance ==
He wears more lace than a Lady. He has a curled mustache and has narrow eyes.

== Activities ==
He met with the [[Amyrlin]] [[Egwene al'Vere]] in [[Salidar]], and he seemed to be trying to garner favor with the Andoran Nobles who are along Andor's border with [[Murandy]].
